notes:
{娘|むすめ} means daughter (family relationship) or a young woman/girl.

TWO MEANINGS:
1. Daughter: one's female child
2. Girl/young woman: unmarried young female (somewhat old-fashioned)

FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧: son
- {娘|むすめ}: daughter
- ⟦お{嬢|じょう}さん→お嬢さん：01566_ojousan⟧: daughter (polite), young lady

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {娘|むすめ}⟦さん→さん：noentry⟧: (your) daughter (polite)
- ⟦{一人娘|ひとりむすめ}→一人娘：08957_hitorimusume⟧: only daughter
- ⟦{娘婿|むすめむこ}→娘婿：27792_musumemuko⟧: son-in-law
- ⟦{箱入り娘|はこいりむすめ}→箱入り娘：noentry⟧: sheltered daughter

USAGE NOTE:
When referring to someone else's daughter politely, use {娘|むすめ}⟦さん→さん：noentry⟧ or ⟦お{嬢|じょう}さん→お嬢さん：01566_ojousan⟧. The second meaning (young woman) is less common in modern speech.
